cpmplus.w3modelexport.menu.take.desc: Skin with the model inside, .cpmmodel file or .cpmproject: which one to use and who sees the model
cpmplus.w3modelexport.menu.cpmmodel.desc: The model file the game lists in Gestures > Models and loads with /cpmclient set_model
cpmplus.w3modelexport.menu.checkSkin.des: Does this PNG carry a CPM model, a link or nothing?
cpmplus.w3modelexport.lock.title: Lock without an owner
cpmplus.w3modelexport.lock.text: This model is locked to a player (UUID lock), but the project does not say WHICH player. Exported from here it would be locked to nobody: blocked for EVERYONE, you included.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.lock.note: 'Export without lock' exports a copy that anyone can wear; the project keeps its lock setting.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.lock.howTo: Open CPM+ > Model settings > Name, description and icon and choose who the model is locked to (the client's account). Then export again.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.layers.stored: skin layers for the custom animations saved in the project
cpmplus.w3modelexport.overflow.title: The model needs a link
cpmplus.w3modelexport.overflow.text: %s KB of the model do not fit directly in the file (CPM's limit is 30 KB). That part has to be published as a link: other players download %s KB.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.overflow.localNote: Local test: the whole model stays inside the file and works for you; other players get nothing for the linked part until it is published.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.audience: Who loads the link: you and friends: yes · safety off: yes · default (medium) safety: %s
cpmplus.w3modelexport.audience.no: no (over 100 KB; ask them to add you as a friend or lower their safety)
cpmplus.w3modelexport.error.title: Could not export
cpmplus.w3modelexport.error.exporter: CPM could not write the model. Run CPM+ > Validate to see what is wrong.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.error.verify: The exported file did not pass the check (it was read back like the game reads it): %s. Nothing was kept.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.error.write: Could not write the file: %s. If the game is open, close its model list and try again.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.error.noWrite: This Blockbench cannot save files here.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.fs.permission: CPM+ wants to save your model in this folder.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.fs.detect: CPM+ wants to look for your Minecraft folders (only reads folder names).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.overwrite.title: Replace file?
cpmplus.w3modelexport.overwrite.text: '%s' already exists and was not made by CPM+. Replace it?
cpmplus.w3modelexport.dir.title: Where is your player_models folder?
cpmplus.w3modelexport.dir.text: CPM reads models from the 'player_models' folder inside your game folder (or instance folder). Pick it once and CPM+ remembers it.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.done.title: Model exported
cpmplus.w3modelexport.done.downloaded: Downloaded: %s. Put it in the game's .minecraft/player_models folder.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.done.howTo: In the game: Gestures > Models, or paste this command in the chat:
cpmplus.w3modelexport.popup.title: Not available in Blockbench
cpmplus.w3modelexport.popup.unsupported: CPM tried to open its window '%s', which does not exist inside Blockbench. Use CPM+ > Take to the game... (it covers model files, skins and links).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.take.title: Take to the game
cpmplus.w3modelexport.take.skin: Skin with the model inside (the server does not need the mod)
cpmplus.w3modelexport.take.skin.who: The server does not need the mod. Players WITH CPM installed see the model; players without it see the normal skin.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.take.model.who: For worlds / servers WITH CPM: you pick it in Gestures > Models and other players with CPM on the server see it.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.take.project.who: To keep editing in CPM's in-game editor; nobody sees it until it is exported from there.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.test.action.desc: Writes a test copy to player_models and copies the command that loads it
cpmplus.w3modelexport.test.label: (test, no lock)
cpmplus.w3modelexport.test.downloaded: Downloaded: %s. Put it in .minecraft/player_models (not in a subfolder).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.test.toast: Done! In game: press T, Ctrl+V, Enter. Next time: T, arrow up, Enter (reloads).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.test.limits: Needs CPM in the world / server (single player works). Other players with CPM on the server may see this test; if the model is big they see only part of it or nothing - to share it, use Export model. To go back to your normal skin: /cpmclient reset_model.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gamedir.title: Game folder for 'Test in game'
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gamedir.text: Pick the game folder (or launcher instance) where CPM is installed. CPM+ writes only into its player_models folder and remembers it for this project.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gamedir.none: No folder with CPM was found automatically. Use 'Browse...'.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gamedir.invalid: This folder does not look like it has CPM installed (no CPM jar in mods/ and no player_models folder).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.title: Skin with the model inside
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.who: The server does not need the mod. Whoever has CPM installed sees the model; whoever does not sees the normal skin (the image below).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.noFit: Does not fit directly (%s KB missing) - we will use a link, that is normal.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.base: Normal skin (what players without CPM see)
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.pickFirst: Choose the PNG first (or another option).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.armHintClassi: Careful: this PNG looks like a Steve skin (wide arms) but the project is Alex (slim).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.armHintSlim: Careful: this PNG looks like an Alex skin (slim arms) but the project is Steve (classic).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.finalNote: Upload exactly this PNG as your skin in the official launcher (minecraft.net / Launcher). Do not open it in another skin editor: the model data lives in its pixels. Offline servers / SkinsRestorer only keep it if the PNG passes unchanged.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.legacy: This is an old 64x32 skin. Convert it first with CPM+ > Texture > Change base skin, then choose it again.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.badSize: The skin must be exactly 64x64 pixels (this one is %sx%s). It is never resized automatically.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.size: The base skin must be exactly 64x64 pixels.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.needsLink: The model does not fit in the skin: it needs a published link.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.noTemplate: CPM's skin template is not loaded yet. Try again in a few seconds.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.verifyFailed: The skin did not pass the check (read back like the game reads it): %s. Nothing was saved.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.linkStored: skin link saved in the project
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.done: Saved: %s (checked: the model data reads back correctly).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.skin.previewNote: This is what players WITHOUT CPM see (the model area of the skin is cleared).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.check.title: Check a skin
cpmplus.w3modelexport.check.noData: No model data (probably the launcher or a website changed the PNG, or it never had a model).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.check.broken: Has model data, but it is damaged (checksum wrong): the PNG was changed after export.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.check.link: Points to the link %s (%s). The model itself is downloaded from there.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.title: Publish the model data
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.intro: The rest of the model goes in a public gist. CPM downloads it from there for every player.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.outdated: The project's published link is OUTDATED: this model changed. Copy the new data, paste it over the old content of the same gist and check again (GitHub may take a few minutes to show the new version).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.step1.text: %s KB of text. It must go in exactly as it is.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.step2.text: On gist.github.com create a PUBLIC gist with ONE file, paste the data (nothing else, no line break at the end), save and copy the page address.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.ok: Gist matches. You can use it.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.checkFirst: Click 'Check gist' first: the link is only used after the content matches.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.badUrl: This address is not accepted by CPM. Use https://gist.github.com/<name>/<id> (or a pastebin.com link).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.pasteNeedsLog: CPM's own paste site needs a Minecraft login and does not work from here. Use a gist.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.notFound: Gist not found: it is private, was deleted, or the address is wrong. Make it PUBLIC.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.httpError: The site answered with error %s. Try again in a moment.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.network: Could not download the gist to check it (no internet or the site blocked it). Try again.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.whitespace: The gist has spaces or a line break before or after the data. CPM fails on that: remove them and save again.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.quotes: The gist has quotes around the data. Remove them and save again.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.oldContent: The gist still has the OLD version of the model. Paste the new data and save (GitHub may take a few minutes to update).
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.extraText: The gist has extra text besides the data. Leave only the copied data in the file.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.otherModel: The gist has data of a different model (or a different version). Copy the data again and paste it over the content.
cpmplus.w3modelexport.gist.wrongFile: The gist content is not this model's data (wrong file?). The gist must have only ONE file with the copied data.
